userText:
Building: Oracle Park, San Francisco (baseball stadium).
The front (−z) is the brick main entrance at Third and King (Willie Mays Plaza); the open outfield faces the bay behind.
Footprint: 205.6 m along x by 270.4 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (approximate: the hull of its OpenStreetMap parts), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-102.8,134.2],[-102.8,-6.1],[-101.9,-77.2],[-70.2,-135.1],[-22.3,-135.2],[3.6,-124.3],[29.1,-111.9],[62.8,-25.8],[102.8,91.5],[79.1,133.9],[77,135.1],[-52.9,135.2]]
Height: the highest point is 45 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. ground-level three-quarter of the brick street-side facade, clock tower and light standards, overcast daylight (older AT&T Park signage)
  2. vertical aerial of the whole ballpark: asymmetric field, horseshoe grandstand, open outfield, waterfront edge, daylight
  3. oblique aerial from the bay side along the right-field edge, showing the open bowl, grandstand tiers and arched promenade wall

Reply with the JSON object only.
